evidence.proved: the page title and meta description returned by the reader were 'TeraBox - Free Cloud Storage Up To 1 TB, Send Large Files Online', and the final URL was /simple-verify with the body 'Verification code was entered incorrectly', so the landing page itself was not served
'1024GB of FREE Cloud Storage' on registration, and 'Upload, store, and share big files up to 128 GB seamlessly'
the vendor landing page, read through a firecrawl pin, states 1024 GB of cloud storage
the 128 GB upload figure applies to Premium users, so it is not the free plan's cap
evidence.quote: Premium users can upload files up to 128 GB at a time.

notes: 1024 GB free is stated by the official site title and by the app store listing. The per-file cap of 128 GB is the app listing's sharing figure and is not the same thing as an upload cap. What could not be established: retention, egress terms, and whether an anonymous or email-only registration produces a usable account. The site returned a verification interstitial to the reader on 2026-10-22, so this is `reported` and not `documented`.
binding_note: The 1 TiB quota is not the constraint; the absence of a documented programmatic interface and of a readable limits page is, because neither the cap nor the retention could be established first-hand.
